ai_verdict.verdict: Start Saquon Barkley as planned, but confirm he's active before kickoff.
ai_verdict.reasoning: An arm issue rarely costs a running back carries, and Chicago is one of the softer run defenses he'll see (ranked 23rd against the position), so the workload and matchup both point to a bounce-back. The 6.0 points per game over his last two is ugly, but two games isn't enough to bench a true workhorse back unless you have another clear starter-quality option.
